title: renderDesign
responsibility: Selects a canvas’s artboards and themes and renders them to the output folder.

inputs.name: renderDesign.service
inputs.description: Canvas service for the selected project root.

inputs.name: renderDesign.canvas
inputs.description: Canvas name, or the canvas data to show or record.

inputs.name: renderDesign.out
inputs.description: Output folder, relative to the project root.

inputs.name: renderDesign.theme
inputs.description: light, dark or both for rendering; light or dark for a viewer.

inputs.name: renderDesign.artboard
inputs.description: Only render the artboard with this name.

outputs.name: renderDesign
outputs.description: Paths of the PNG files written.

errors.name: DesignCanvasError
errors.description: A canvas, artboard, option or prerequisite is not usable; the message says why.
